children: InspireMD entered into amendments with certain holders of its Series J and Series K warrants to adjust pricing and terms. For 50% of the shares under amending holders' Series J warrants and all shares under their Series K warrants, the exercise price is set at $0.7674 (less $0.0001 for pre-funded elections) and the expiration becomes the earlier of May 15, 2028 or 20 trading days after FDA approval of CGuard Prime 80 cm. Other terms remain unchanged, and non-amending holders' warrants are unaffected. Some participating holders include directors.
: Amendments to Series J and Series K common stock purchase warrants
: To earlier of May 15 2028 or 20 trading days after FDA approval
: Encourage warrant exercises and align with FDA approval milestone

title: InspireMD Lowers Warrant Exercise Price to $0.7674, Adds 2028/FDA Approval Expiration Trigger
